eligibility: contingent: neither the contract ('bounded to 2MiB') nor the clarifications ('Inputs are bounded to2MiB') say whether exactly 2097152 bytes is allowed; freeze only if Main rules the bound inclusive, else exclude visibly
rationale: A boundary companion to AuditRawOversizedSnapshot: the same valid clean receipt padded to exactly 2097152 bytes, with the actual digest. Reading 'bounded to 2 MiB' as at most 2097152 bytes, this is valid and consistent: 0/evidence_audit_clean. This pins the off-by-one and kills a mutant using '>=' as the reject condition. If Main rules the bound exclusive, the expectation flips to 2/evidence_audit_input_invalid. That is why this is contingent and must not be frozen until decided.
